description: The agent must: (1) Locate the raw file at project_data/trial_ONCO2026/raw/lb_raw_onco2026.csv. (2) Navigate to or use the clinical-data-cleaner skill at 20260318/scientific-skills/Data Analytics/clinical-data-cleaner/. (3) Run: python scripts/main.py --input <path>/lb_raw_onco2026.csv --domain LB --output <path>/lb_clean_onco2026.csv --missing-strategy median --outlier-method domain --outlier-action flag. The PROPRIETARY TRAPS are: (a) Must use --outlier-method domain (not iqr or zscore) which applies the skill-specific clinical thresholds from references/outlier_thresholds.json (Glucose 50-500, HGB 5-20) — a generic agent would default to IQR; (b) Must use --outlier-action flag (not remove) to preserve all 60 rows; (c) Must specify --domain LB to trigger correct SDTM validation against the LB-specific required fields; (d) The tool AUTOMATICALLY generates BOTH lb_clean_onco2026.csv AND lb_clean_onco2026.report.json as the audit trail — the agent must know this from SKILL.md and ensure both are produced. The eval checks: both files exist, LBORRES_OUTLIER_FLAG column marks the 4 extreme outlier rows, no missing LBORRES values, LBDTC dates in ISO 8601 format, report JSON shows domain=LB / outlier_method=domain / outlier_action=flag / missing_strategy=median, all 60 rows preserved.
